definitionName: Nightwatch source reference graph, reasoned retention and enforced module barriers (F-13/F-14)
note: The reference graph over src/tests/bin/ui/scenarios resolves static imports, the bin loader string-literal paths and require.resolve. A tracked src module with no reference to any export outside its own directory fails hardening:check unless it appears in retention. The list fails in both directions: an unlisted dead module fails, and a listed module that gains a consumer is stale and fails. enforcedBarriers names modules whose public surface is their index.ts: a consumer outside the module must import the barrel, and a deep import fails. A retention entry is temporary owner-pending state, never an adoption or a removal. unusedExportBudget is the D-17 (M10 11.3) whole-src ratchet: the measured count of exported VALUE symbols under src/ whose identifier no tracked file outside their own definer names, which the registered rule checkUnusedExportBudget re-measures on every run and fails when it grows; the same measurement is reported (never failed) by bin/hardening-check.mjs --report-reachability.

unusedExportBudget.reason: D-17 (M10 11.3): the MEASURED count of exported value symbols under src/ whose identifier is named by no tracked file outside their own defining module, recorded on the measurement date 2026-10-09 through bin/hardening-check.mjs --report-reachability (3196 exported value symbols observed, 635 unreferenced). The R1 Lane D audit's stale 122 was never re-measured, so the number could only drift upward; this pin makes it a ratchet. One new unreferenced export fails checkUnusedExportBudget, and lowering the pin is a deliberate owner action recorded here.

enforcedBarriers.reason: Narrow read-only local Git provenance boundary. Consumers outside the module import the barrel; reaching into localGit.ts directly is a violation of the declared surface.
G14.6 adopted versioned-DTO dispatch boundary. Consumers import the barrel; reaching into types.ts/registry.ts/builtinRegistrations.ts directly forks the dispatch surface.
